name: Specter
languages: Understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

specialAbilities.name: Incorporeal Movement
specialAbilities.description: The specter can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

specialAbilities.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
specialAbilities.description: While in sunlight, the specter has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, its Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken.
